# Task 6 — complete offline

Reused logical inventory exclusion and exact batch/prompt/reference/price binding. Route and review versions are now in the bound manifest. Structured authorizations must be explicitly labeled offline-fixture, and boolean price ceilings fail. One durable record per encountered channel retains priced revisions, inventory evidence and zero-spend execution history. A read-only diagnostic returns prices and blockers even when inventory coverage is incomplete; it never claims production executability or changes scope to fit a cap.

Validation: 16 cumulative hardening tests pass, including route changes, malformed ceilings, revision history and blocked diagnostic estimates. Existing exclusion, dollar-string, atomic reservation and tampered-input cases are retained. Authoritative production inventory completeness, approval intake and shared spend reservations remain separate integration work.
